answer: Trust is an edge with a half-life, so a vouch issued in one epoch is worth half in the next and nothing after three, which forces every identity to keep doing work instead of sitting on an old reference, the way a vine keeps climbing or loses its grip. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so an expired edge cannot be replayed into a live one. A node on the ridge sees the whole nebula and still cannot tell which star is real. Work does.
